title: A Drive to Salò
introTitle: A meaningful morning, then Lake Garda.
intro:
Today began a little differently. Rather than immediately heading out to explore another part of Italy, I spent the morning with new friends here in Brescia, sharing something meaningful and getting to know them a bit better. It reminded me that some of the most memorable parts of this journey aren't always the landscapes or famous landmarks, but the people I meet along the way.

With a rewarding morning behind me, it was time for another adventure. Today's destination: Salò, along the beautiful shores of Lake Garda. After days of dramatic mountain scenery and winding roads, I'm looking forward to a change of pace, some time along the waterfront, and another opportunity to appreciate northern Italy. More to come as the day unfolds.
